title: Draining Peatlands Linked to Global Warming
excerpt: A detailed new estimate spanning back to 1800 calculates the carbon liberated by draining peatlands.
body_html: A detailed new estimate tracking carbon emissions back to 1800 indicates that draining peatlands accounts for a few percent of global warming. The research provides a comprehensive look at how much carbon is liberated into the atmosphere when these lands are drained over time.
